foundation.framingA.title: Wo ke kopano ya rena ya pele.
foundation.framingA.body:
Dipotšišo tše di homokego tše šupa — efela o ka ema ka morago ga tše tharo wa bona mmalo wa gago wa pele.

Ga go na dikarabo tše di nepagetšego. Go ba le nnete go feta go kgahla.

Wo ga se teko. Ke senepe sa pele sa mo o lego gona gona bjale, gore nka kopana le wena gona moo.
foundation.framingA.skip: Tlola gona bjale — šomiša tša tlhaho
foundation.framingB.title: Wo ke motheo wa gago.
foundation.framingB.body:
Se o sa tšwago go mpha sona se ba legohle la gago la mathomo.

Matšatšing a latelang ke tla tšwela pele ke beakanya — wo ga se teko, ke senepe sa pele.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Tlola pele — bontšha mmalo waka bjale
foundation.q1.title: Ke mekgwa efe ye e goeledšago go wena gona bjale?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Go fihla go tše 3. Ba le nnete.
foundation.q1.opt1: Ga go lekane — ga ke dire se se lekanego
foundation.q1.opt2: Taolo — ge nka lesa, tšohle di a wa
foundation.q1.opt3: Go tloša maikutlo — tlhakatlhakano, goeta, go fihliša maikutlo
foundation.q1.opt4: Go tshwenyega — letšhogo le le swanago, pale e swanago, lefokisi le le swanago
foundation.q1.opt5: Go kgahliša batho — nka se kgone go gana
foundation.q1.opt6: Boitsebišo — 'ke nna mang ka nnete?' bo ka se tsoge bo tloga
foundation.q1.opt7: Pefelo / galefo — e hlatloga ka pela
foundation.q1.opt8: Papiso — bophelo bja bona, go hloka ga ka
foundation.q2.title: Ke lebelo la phurogo le ka kgonago go leemeletša gona bjale?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Ga se nyako. Seo bophelo bja gago bja bjale bo tlago go se fa ka nnete.
foundation.q2.opt1: Bonolo — mokete o mongwe o monyenyane, wo o emetšego go iša pele
foundation.q2.opt2: Gare — phurogo ya letšatši le letšatši, bogare bja maatla
foundation.q2.opt3: Šoro — ke nyaka tapas, ke nyaka e fiša
foundation.q2.opt4: Wa baitlami — ke nyaka bontši bja letšatši ka gare ga mo
foundation.q3.title: Ge o lora mmušo wa gago o mobotse kudu, ke...
foundation.q3.opt1: Lokologile — ka mehla o ithuta, ka mehla o sepela
foundation.q3.opt2: O ratana — o nyamile ka gare ga sengwe se segolo
foundation.q3.opt3: O sa šuthe — o phunya ka gare ga sengwe le sengwe
foundation.q3.opt4: Bohlale — go homola, go hlakile, ba bangwe ba tla go bona
foundation.q3.opt5: Magareng ga lefase — go bona se ba bangwe ba sa se bonego
foundation.q3.opt6: Bokgoni bja go homola bjoo batho ba fodišago kgauswi le bjona
foundation.q3.opt7: Bophelo ka botlalo — bja maikutlo, bja kgauswi, mo
foundation.q3.opt8: Go dira sengwe seo lefase le sa se bonago
foundation.q3.opt9: Go swara ntlô / mmušo / sehlopha gabotse
foundation.q3.opt10: Go gana maaka — gae le ge o le nosi
foundation.q3.opt11: O le nosi thabeng, o sa tshutšwe
foundation.q3.opt12: Botlhokwa — ditiro tše nnyane, tše di dirwautog
foundation.q4.title: Ke sekggeo sefe se se lego kgauswi le wena bjale?
foundation.q4.opt4: Kutugo — go dula ka kgutso, boteng
foundation.q4.opt5: Mmele o mokgethwa — moya, maatla, go loga
foundation.q4.opt6: Tiro ya maatla — moya, mahlale a ka gare, bophelo
foundation.q5.title: O tlile mo go tlo nagana gape ka eng?
foundation.q5.opt1: Tumelo ye ke e tšeerego go tloga bengwaneng
foundation.q5.opt2: Kamano ya ka le ba bangwe
foundation.q5.opt3: Kamano ya ka le tiro gotee le maiteko
foundation.q5.opt4: Tsela ye ke swarago mmele wo ka yona
foundation.q5.opt5: Se ke dumellago go se ikwa
foundation.q5.opt6: Ke mang yo ke naganago gore ke yena
foundation.q6.title: Ke eng se se kwagalago e le nnete kudu?
foundation.q6.opt2: Ke na le kgetho tseleng ye ke arabago ka yona
foundation.q6.opt3: Tlhokomelo e bopa nnete ya ka
foundation.q7.title: Ge go direga se se boima, o ya kae pele?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Hlokomela mogato wa pele kudu.
foundation.q7.opt1: Mo hlogo ya ka — sekaseka, rera, bušetša morago
foundation.q7.opt2: Ka pelong ya ka — ikwa, phallela motho
foundation.q7.opt3: Kgatong ya tiro — šutha, lokisa, dira sengwe
foundation.q8.title: O tsepame go lebelela dikgopolo tša gago go lekana bokae?
foundation.q8.opt2: Ke lekile, ka dinako tše dingwe
foundation.q8.opt4: Ke karolo ye e tiistetšego ya bophelo bja ka
foundation.analysis.eyebrow: Se ke se bonago ke se
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Se se tla fetoga ge o ntse o praktika. Ga go na se se tiilego — ke yona ntlha.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Re tla bala se gape matšatši a mangwe le a mangwe. Magoro a a šutha. Ke yona ntlha.
foundation.brain.head.label: Go etelwa ke hlogo
foundation.brain.heart.label: Go etelwa ke pelo
foundation.brain.gut.label: Ka mala
foundation.brain.head.line: O nagana pele. Re tla hlompha seo, mme re rute mmele go fihlela.
foundation.brain.heart.line: O utlwa pele. Re tla boloka seo se bulegile, mme re tsenye hlatse ka morago ga sona.
foundation.brain.gut.line: O tsamaya pele. Re tla go fokotsa lebelo go lekana go utlwa se se lego ka tlase.
foundation.analysis.loopsEmpty: Ga go na sepe se se goletseng gonale — re tla di fitlhela mo tirong.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: O ka kgona go boela kwa go baleng ga gago morago go tswa go Di-Setting. Ga go na sepe se se feletseng.
foundation.paths.eyebrow: Tsela ya gago e e sa tang pele
foundation.paths.title: Kgetha balekane ba gago.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Go bona ke motheo — tsela nngwe le nngwe e thoma gone moo. Kgetha ditsela tse 2–3 tse di go utlwisang botlhoko kgotsa di phedileng go wena jaanong. O ka oketsa gape morago.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Go lebelela se se leng gone, ntle le go tshwara kgotsa go sutisa. Tsela nngwe le nngwe e re e tsamayang mmogo e thoma mo setulong se.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: E ke ntlha ya gago ya thomišo — e seng kgolegelo. Tsela ya gago e tla fetoga jaaka wena.
foundation.archetype.creator: Mmopi
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Modiro wa maatla ka moya le mahlale a ka gare.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Modiro ntle le tlemagano. Tirelo bjalo ka thapelo.
foundation.path.bhakti.blurb: Boineelo. Go lesa pelo e eta pele.
foundation.path.jnana.blurb: Nyakišišo. Go phunya maaka ka tshedimošo.
foundation.path.tantra.blurb: Tšohle di kgethehile. Ga go na se se ntšhwago.
foundation.path.dhyana.blurb: Go dula ka khutšo. Boteng ka go se šuthe.
